# Adrian Treleaven

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 c23 P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008)</sub>
- **Origin:** Toronto, Ontario  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019)</sub>
- **Role:** Journalist and writer  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 c23 P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023), [v4 c24 P27](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0027)</sub>

## Appearance

Adrian is a tall, broad-shouldered, and attractive man with dense brown hair, a sharp nose and chin, and well-shaped ears. He has expansive, luminous dark-gray eyes and clean white teeth that show when he grins. When smiling, his face lights up with wit and charm, though his countenance can appear sorrowful and distracted when serious or weary.

_Sources: [v4 c23 P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 c23 P9](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0009), [v4 c23 P10](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0010), [v4 c24 P4](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0004), [v4 c26 P1](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0001)_

## Personality

Adrian is passionate, articulate, and deeply artistic, possessing an imaginative spirit that connects readily with others. He is amiable, funny, and warm-hearted, easily captivating those around him with his pleasant disposition and engaging conversation. Although conscientious and deeply principled—choosing to suffer in silence rather than compromise a married woman's honor—he can be prone to intense emotional distress when torn by love and sympathy.

_Sources: [v4 c23 P10](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0010), [v4 c24 P7](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0007), [v4 c25 P13](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0013), [v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 c26 P5](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0005), [v4 c26 P13](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0013)_

## History

After recovering from typhoid fever in Toronto, Adrian traveled to Seven Gulls to regain his health and explore the ancient homestead of his grandparents, boarding with Lorna Vane. During his stay, Nell Carrow introduced him to Captain Saul Garrick, whose life stories and journal inspired Adrian to write a novel. He spent the summer collaborating with Captain Saul to complete *The Life-Book of Captain Saul*, while forming a close bond with the local community. Over the course of the season, Adrian fell deeply in love with Lorna, but maintained silence regarding his feelings due to her marital situation, departing quietly at the end of the summer in great anguish. Following the revelation that Lorna's husband was dead and her marriage invalid, Adrian returned the following summer to court her. He proposed to Lorna in the garden of the small house of dreams, and their wedding was planned for Christmas. In addition, his co-authored book with Captain Saul was successfully published, and he made plans to purchase Lorna's old property as a summer home.

## Background by volume

- He is the grandson of John Tremayne, the original schoolmaster at the Glen  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019)</sub>
- His mother was Alice Tremayne, who passed away when he was a young boy  <sub>[v4 c24 P22](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0022), [v4 c24 P25](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0025)</sub>
- He suffered a severe bout of typhoid fever prior to coming to Seven Gulls  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019)</sub>

> Lorna is loved by me, Mrs. Carrow. LOVED! A word that faint hardly seems sufficient!  <sub>[v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002)</sub>

> The soul will be provided by you and the body by me. Oh, Captain Saul, a renowned book will be authored by the two of us. And our labor will commence immediately.  <sub>[v4 c25 P6](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0006)</sub>

> Seven Gulls will never see me again, nor will the memory ever leave me  <sub>[v4 c26 P20](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0020)</sub>
